stem.text: A ball falls towards the ground from point X. Point X is $2.4\,\text{m}$ above the ground.
The ball rebounds from the ground and rises to point Y. Point Y is $1.8\,\text{m}$ above the ground.
A single value of the change in height $\Delta h$ is used to calculate the change in gravitational potential energy of the ball from X to Y.
What is the magnitude of $\Delta h$?
